name: catalogue-empty
assert: document.body.innerText.includes('This facility has no lab tests yet')&&document.body.innerText.includes('Choose from standard tests')&&document.body.innerText.includes('Upload a list of tests')&&document.body.innerText.includes('Add a single test')&&!document.body.innerText.includes('unlisted requests')
description: An empty catalogue offers standard tests, upload and single entry, without the unlisted-requests switch

name: catalogue-standard-sheet
description: Standard tests are read from the server, with no unit or location to choose
Chosen standard tests are added by the server and the list refreshes

name: catalogue-table
description: One table without tabs or a row count, unpriced standard tests show a dash
A price can be entered for a standard test

label: Add tests
assert: [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=menu] button')].map(n=>n.textContent.trim()).join('|')==='Add a single test|Upload a list of tests|Choose from standard tests'
description: Add tests offers single entry, upload and standard tests

name: visit-lab-order
description: Tests added to the catalogue can be requested in a visit, alongside a test not on the list

name: lab-queue
description: Requested catalogue and unlisted tests appear in the Laboratory queue

name: visit-waiting-results
assert: document.body.innerText.includes('Waiting for laboratory results')&&document.body.innerText.includes('Full blood count, Serum ferritin')&&[...[...document.querySelectorAll('nav')].find(n=>n.getAttribute('aria-label')==='Visit tasks').querySelectorAll('button')].map(n=>n.querySelector('span').textContent).join('|')==='Vitals|Complaint|Testing decision|Lab order|Results|Result review|Diagnosis|Prescription|Injection order|Disposition'
description: After ordering, the visit waits for results before the diagnosis, in the one visit order

assert: document.body.innerText.includes('Record why you are continuing without the results')
description: Continuing without results needs a reason

fill.label: Reason for continuing without results
fill.value: Treating on clinical grounds; results will be reviewed when back

description: The reason for continuing without results is signed with the diagnosis

name: visit-diagnosed-without-results
assert: document.body.innerText.includes('Diagnosis signed and saved on this device')
description: The diagnosis is accepted with the recorded reason
A single test matching another test's other name is refused

name: catalogue-offline
assert: document.querySelector('dialog[open]').innerText.includes('Connect to the internet to add tests')
description: Adding tests offline explains that a connection is needed
